_note: DATA, not logic. Search-time use of the knowledge graph (server/src/graph.ts). relWeights: how strongly a neighbour of a strong hit is boosted, per relation. seeds: how many top hits count as strong; a seed must also be a lexical match scoring >= seedMinRatio x the best score. Only neighbours that themselves match the query lexically are boosted. The boost weight itself is env SEARCH_W_GRAPH (default in graph.ts); 0 = graph expansion off.
